title: EnableCollisions - Debug
content:
Member of: Debug Script Enables/disables collisions in the game Syntax: Function EnableCollisions(bool abEnable = true) native global debugOnly Parameters: - abEnable: True to enable collisions, false to disable them Default: True Return Value: None Examples: ; Enable collisions Debug.EnableCollisions()
; Disable collisions Debug.EnableCollisions(false) See Also: - Debug Script
